title: Size vs per-push delta, decoupled

machine.aes_note: Transport AEAD is hkdf-sha512-pad+HMAC-SHA-512-256; hardware AES unused on application transport hot path

methodology.push_dispersion: every push in a cell is a sample, so push_ms carries n = depth
methodology.payload: source-shaped compressible text, not random bytes
methodology.plain_git_arm: matched byte-identical commits pushed to a local git daemon over git://; clone from the receive-pack state, without pre-clone gc
methodology.arm_order: alternated per push and clone repetition

attribution.note: Arm A holds the delta constant so any trend is depth; arm B holds the depth constant so any trend is delta. Slopes are least-squares fits over the medians of the cells in each arm.

notes: The existing size sweep is unchanged and remains published in additive-scale-latest.json; this artifact is additive.
clone_ms_per_head is reported per cell so the depth term is visible without reading the fit.
